$comment: Declared shared inventory pools (#9). Groups of quantity-break variants that
sell the same physical stock through separate Shopify inventory items.
This file is the source of truth, deliberately. The grouping is a fact about
fulfilment, not about naming, and a title convention will drift — so a group
is a group because it is written here, never because a regex matched.
`inventory_pools` in the MCP surfaces UNDECLARED candidates so a new
quantity-break product is noticed rather than silently unmonitored.
packSize is units per pack. A variant's `quantity` in Shopify is how many
packs can be made, NOT how many units are held.

pools.note: 2023 Halloween design. Seven pack sizes over one pool, all UNLISTED, all selling.
2022 Halloween design. Same shape as Spooky Spells.
